adjudication.rationale: In the newly added `EmbeddableHost` model, the `before_validation` block calls `self.host.sub!(...)` twice without guarding against `self.host` being `nil` (app/models/embeddable_host.rb). Since there is no explicit presence validation for `:host` (only `validates_format_of`), and the controller assigns `host.host = params[:embeddable_host][:host]` which can be missing/`nil` (Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host), a create/update request without `host` would hit the callback and raise `NoMethodError` instead of producing a validation error response.
